versions.content: The LIN Interface shall set the sub - state of a channel to LINTP_CHANNEL_BUSY when it has received a FF or a SF on the channel and it has detected it as a TP message (i.e. not conflicting w ith a configuration response from a LIN slave node or a configuration request from a LIN master node ).
